tutorial.intro: Bourré is a Louisiana classic blending poker betting with trick-taking. Everyone antes into the pot, and the dealer's last card sets the trump suit.
tutorial.decide: Look at your five cards and the trump suit, then decide: play (commit to the hand) or fold. Play but win zero tricks and you're 'bourréd' — you owe the entire pot.
tutorial.draw: If you play, you may discard unwanted cards and draw replacements, just like draw poker.
tutorial.play: Follow the led suit if you can; if void, you must play trump. You must also beat the trick whenever able. Win the most of five tricks to take the pot.
